title: Cracked Magazine #137 - November 1976 Special Fun-Filled Summer Ed. Complete
descriptionText: The Cracked Magazine #137 from November 1976 is a special summer edition packed with fun and humor. This collector's edition, first edition magazine features topics related to movie adaptations and is published by DELL in the United States. With its annual publication frequency and English language, this magazine is a must-have for fans of humor and satire. Perfect for those looking to enjoy a light-hearted read filled with entertainment and laughter.
